briefing: - 今日未见在野利用或勒索软件标记，暂无已遭利用证据。
- 最高危CVE-2026-124580命令注入10.0，应立即修复。
- jpom漏洞已有PoC且CVSS9.8，暴露实例立即修复。
- 批量公告集中于OA协同办公RCE、命令注入、认证绕过与授权错误。
- 优先处置9.8以上RCE/认证绕过和ERP越权，再排查硬编码密钥。

items.title: Jpom查询条件注入认证绕过致RCE
items.title_zh: Jpom查询条件注入认证绕过致RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证者向JPOM-USER-TOKEN头注入'is not null'绕过认证取得超管权限，再经脚本功能执行命令。
items.action_zh: 升级至2.11.13，并排查异常超管登录与脚本执行
items.repro_note: JPOM-USER-TOKEN头填is not null提权后调脚本接口执行
items.impact_scope: 内网运维平台,常暴露公网
items.description: Jpom 2.10.0 through 2.11.12 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain super-administrator access by injecting query conditions into the JPOM-USER-TOKEN header. Attackers can send a value like 'is not null', which Hutool's Condition parser treats as an operator, then execute commands through Jpom's script features.

items.title: Tomcat JNDI域SASL认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 启用JNDI域且配非GSSAPI SASL机制时，远程攻击者无需正确口令即可通过认证访问应用。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级Tomcat至修复版本，非必要不启用JNDI域+SASL
items.repro_note: 配置JNDI域与非GSSAPI SASL机制后，不带正确口令发起认证
items.impact_scope: Web中间件,内网应用服务器常见
items.description: A missing critical step in authentication vulnerability in Apache Tomcat when the JNDI realm was configured with with a non GSSAPI SASL authentication mechanism allowed attackers to authenticate without providing the correct password. This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.0-M1 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.0.M1 through 9.0.122.

items.title: Web中间件未认证请求触发越界写
items.title_zh: Web中间件未认证请求触发越界写
items.summary_zh: 未认证者发单个HTTP请求致worker指针解引用并常量写入，内存破坏可致崩溃、泄密或代码执行。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商公告定位组件并及时升级对应中间件
items.repro_note: 未认证HTTP请求触发，受影响产品未明确需先定位组件
items.impact_scope: Web中间件,常暴露公网
items.description: A single crafted unauthenticated HTTP request can make a worker dereference the pointer, resulting in a constant-value write to an attacker-controlled address. The resulting memory corruption can terminate the worker and may disclose memory or redirect execution.

items.title: OA协同办公低权限代码注入RCE
items.title_zh: OA协同办公低权限代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 低权限用户经远程接口提交特制输入注入并执行任意代码，严重危及系统机密性、完整性与可用性。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商补丁，限制远程接口暴露并收敛低权限账号
items.repro_note: 需低权限账号，向远程接口参数注入代码触发执行
items.impact_scope: OA系统,内网广泛部署且常对外
items.description: SAP NetWeaver does not perform necessary authorization checks and lacks sufficient input validation in certain remote-enabled functionality. An attacker with low privileges could send specially crafted input through a remote interface to inject and execute arbitrary code within the affected system. Successful exploitation could extend the attacker's reach beyond the vulnerable component, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability.

items.title: OA协同办公XSL转换注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 已登录且有功能权限的用户可令系统处理恶意XSL转换，在应用上下文执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，禁用不受控的外部XSL转换
items.repro_note: 需认证并有功能权限，提交恶意XSL模板触发转换
items.impact_scope: OA系统,内网协同办公入口
items.description: SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management (XML Forms) does not sufficiently restrict the selection of XSL transformations processed by the affected functionality. Under certain conditions, an authenticated user with access to the affected functionality could cause an unauthorized XSL transformation to be processed, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution in the application context. Successful exploitation could impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application.

items.title: SAP NetWeaver RFC请求内存破坏
items.title_zh: SAP NetWeaver RFC请求内存破坏
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可向ABAP应用服务器发特制RFC请求触发内存管理逻辑错误，导致内存破坏与数据篡改。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 按SAP安全公告更新内核补丁，限制RFC端口访问
items.repro_note: 向SAP RFC端口发特制请求，触发内存管理逻辑错误
items.impact_scope: SAP ABAP应用服务器,企业核心系统
items.description: Due to improper RFC protocol validation in the SAP Kernel used by the Application Server ABAP of SAP NetWeaver and ABAP Platform, an unauthenticated attacker can send a crafted RFC request that exploits logical errors in memory management, leading to memory corruption. This could lead to a high impact on confidentiality and integrity with low impact on availability of the application.

items.title: VW2100设备extend参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可向设备接口extend参数注入系统命令并以高权限执行，从而完全控制设备。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取固件更新，隔离设备管理网络
items.repro_note: 向设备管理接口extend参数注入系统命令执行
items.impact_scope: 物联网通信设备,管理网暴露
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Chengdu Feiyuxing Technology VW2100 and VEC10GP 1.0 B-MB3W202-210825-r11775. This impacts the function handle_wechat_cn_wifi of the file var/html/webserver of the component Weixin Auth Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument extend results in os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: VW2100设备mac参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可向设备接口mac参数注入系统命令并以高权限执行，导致设备失陷与配置被篡改。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取固件更新，隔离设备管理网络
items.repro_note: 向设备接口mac参数注入系统命令，认证要求待确认
items.impact_scope: 物联网通信设备,管理网暴露
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Chengdu Feiyuxing Technology VW2100 and VEC10GP 1.0 B-MB3W202-210825-r11775. This issue affects the function add_expmac of the file var/html/webserver of the component Web Administration Interface. The manipulation of the argument mac results in os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Executing 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: A weakness has been identified in Intelbras SG 2404 PoE L2+ 1.00.70/1.00.72. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /EXCU_SHELL of the component Web Management Interface. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authentication. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 1.00.74 is sufficient to fix this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

items.title: SAP Gateway 未授权 授权错误
items.description: SAP Gateway activates the default Access Control List with high privileges allowing categorization of external attacker as internal application server. As a result an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the SAP Gateway could exploit this weakness to potentially perform unauthorized actions within the application environment, resulting in a high impact on the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.

items.title: CUD-target 越权(IDOR)
items.description: In a licensed multi-tenant deployment with multiple applications under one non-default connection URI domain and separate api_keys, an attacker holding one application's valid API key can update the parent domain because the CUD-target branch checks the domain without requiring the source application and tenant to be public.

items.title: rConfig核心队列反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证网络攻击者可向未设防的Redis Horizon队列投递恶意序列化任务，实现远程代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级Core 8.2.19/Pro 8.4.1，并为Redis加认证
items.repro_note: Redis未授权可达时推入恶意序列化job由Horizon消费
items.impact_scope: 网络设备配置管理,内网运维
items.description: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.19 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.1 contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows unauthenticated network attackers to execute arbitrary code by pushing a crafted serialized job onto the Redis-backed Laravel Horizon queue, which runs without authentication in affected deployments.

items.title: Redpanda Connect 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: Redpanda Connect versions 4.39 to 4.110 contain a missing authentication vulnerability that enables unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). An unauthenticated attacker with network access to TCP/4195 can `POST` a malicious pipeline definition to `/streams/{id}` that includes code-executing processors such as `command`, `subprocess`, `ffi`, or unsafe `sql_raw`, thereby achieving arbitrary RCE on the host with the permissions of the Redpanda Connect service account.

items.title: Kubero 未授权 CWE-321
items.description: Kubero 3.0.0 through 3.1.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to forge administrative JWTs by using a hardcoded fallback signing secret when JWT_SECRET is unset. Attackers can sign tokens with arbitrary role, userGroups and permissions claims, which JwtStrategy.validate() trusts without a database lookup, to take control of pipelines, applications, users and API tokens.

items.title: INDOTALENT WHMS 未授权 CWE-321
items.description: INDOTALENT WHMS (Asp.Net-Core-Inventory-Order-Management-System) before 10.20261109 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability caused by a hard-coded JWT signing key, issuer and audience in appsettings.json. Unauthenticated remote attackers can forge tokens for any user ID and role that the Tokens/DI.cs validator trusts, gaining administrator access to the entire API.

items.title: INDOTALENT WHMS 未授权 默认凭据
items.description: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 contains a default credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrator access because UserAdminSeeder creates admin@root.com with password 123456. Attackers can log in with these credentials, which carry every admin role and no forced password change, to fully control deployments that kept them.

items.title: Webhook密钥缺省致eval注入RCE
items.summary_zh: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET未配置时签名校验被跳过，未认证者可控输入进入eval执行任意Python。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 强制配置WEBHOOK_SECRET并校验签名，升级修复版
items.repro_note: 密钥为空时未认证POST webhook即触发eval执行
items.impact_scope: 自研Web服务,公网GitHub回调
items.description: The otterdog webapp evaluates a format-string built from the incoming GitHub webhook JSON body using Python's eval(). When the GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET configuration value is unset or empty (the code default is None), the HMAC signature check is skipped entirely, allowing an unauthenticated network client to reach the eval() sink with attacker-controlled input and execute arbitrary Python on the webapp host.

items.title: Airflow XCom反序列化致RCE
items.summary_zh: 具Dag编写权限者可写入特制XCom，待他人经API查看并反序列化实例化airflow.*类，导致代码执行。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Airflow修复版本，关闭API反序列化解析
items.repro_note: 需Dag作者权限写XCom，API开反序列化后查看触发
items.impact_scope: 数据调度平台,内网大数据环境
items.description: Apache Airflow's Task Execution API stored XCom values written by a task without the reserved-key check applied elsewhere, so a Dag author's task could write an XCom that, when a user later viewed it through the API with deserialization enabled, made the API server instantiate classes from the `airflow.*` namespace with arguments the Dag author chose.

items.title: HPE Morpheus远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: HPE Morpheus存在远程代码执行问题，攻击者可执行任意代码；入口与认证要求需查厂商公告。
items.action_zh: 关注HPE安全公告并尽快应用官方补丁
items.repro_note: 证据未给出入口，需按厂商公告确认接口与前置条件
items.impact_scope: 云管理平台,内网运维核心
items.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in HPE Morpheus Software.

items.title: ASUS路由器未认证命令注入
items.title_zh: ASUS路由器未认证命令注入
items.summary_zh: 近场未认证攻击者可经查询、标识猜测、凭证覆写到命令注入的链条，以root权限执行任意命令。
items.action_zh: 升级华硕固件，关闭WAN侧管理与相关服务
items.repro_note: 近场未认证查询并猜测标识、覆写凭证后注入命令
items.impact_scope: 家用/小型企业路由器,边界设备
items.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command in certain ASUS Router firmware allows an unauthenticated nearby user to trigger a chain of actions—unauthenticated queries, identifier guessing, credential overwriting, and command injection—resulting in the execution of arbitrary commands with root privileges. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: Illumio VEN搜索路径劫持提权
items.title_zh: Illumio VEN搜索路径劫持提权
items.summary_zh: 本地低权限认证用户可借内置OpenSSL库搜索路径缺陷，以SYSTEM权限执行任意代码。
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级VEN组件，修复前收紧本地登录用户权限
items.impact_scope: 终端安全Agent,本地提权
items.description: The OpenSSL library bundled with the Illumio VEN for Windows is affected by an uncontrolled search path vulnerability. A low-privileged, authenticated local attacker could potentially leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.

items.title: OmniAgent命令白名单绕过执行
items.summary_zh: 被提示注入的Agent可用find -execdir绕过审批，在无沙箱shell中调用dd/nc执行代码或覆写文件。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交，取消find快捷放行并加沙箱
items.repro_note: 提示注入Agent后提交find -execdir命令绕过审批
items.impact_scope: AI Agent工具,内网自动化执行
items.description: OmniAgent through commit 12b98c5 contains an approval bypass vulnerability in ReflexionAgent._is_safe_bash_command that treats any command starting with find as safe without inspecting -execdir arguments. Prompt-injected agents can run find with -execdir to invoke binaries like dd, nc, perl or openssl through an unsandboxed shell, overwriting files or executing code without human approval.

items.title: WordPress MCP插件权限提升
items.summary_zh: 低权限用户可利用该插件错误的权限分配提升至更高权限，进而篡改站点配置与数据。
items.action_zh: 升级插件至2.0.2以上或停用MCP Server插件
items.impact_scope: WordPress站点,第三方插件风险
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in AtlasAiDev MCP Server for WordPress ai-workflow-automation-ai-agent-hub allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects MCP Server for WordPress: from n/a through 2.0.1.

items.title: WidzialniCMS任意文件上传RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可控制权限参数与currentpath路径向任意目录上传文件并执行代码，完全控制服务器。
items.action_zh: 升级至2.5版本，临时下线save_photo.php上传接口
items.repro_note: POST /panel/controllers/save_photo.php控制权限参数与currentpath
items.impact_scope: CMS站点,面向公网Web
items.description: WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Unrestricted File Upload in the /panel/controllers/save_photo.php endpoint. Due to a client-controlled permission check parameter and insufficient validation of the currentpath parameter, an unauthenticated attacker can upload arbitrary files to any locations on the server, leading to Remote Code Execution. This issue has been fixed in version 2.5.

items.title: WidzialniCMS 任意文件上传
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者经upload.php上传任意文件至可控路径，导致RCE
items.action_zh: 升级到 2.5 修复版本
items.repro_note: 入口 /panel/upload.php，未授权，控制 uploadPath 参数
items.impact_scope: Web CMS，常暴露公网
items.description: WidzialniCMS is vulnerable to Unrestricted File Upload in the /panel/upload.php endpoint. Due to a client-controlled permission check parameter and insufficient validation of the uploadPath parameter, an unauthenticated attacker can upload arbitrary files to any locations on the server, leading to Remote Code Execution. This issue has been fixed in version 2.5.

items.title: OA协同办公 低权限命令执行
items.title_zh: OA协同办公 低权限命令执行
items.summary_zh: 低权限攻击者调用受影响功能，可在主机执行任意OS命令并完全控制
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息，限制低权限账号
items.repro_note: 需低权限账号，调用受影响功能执行OS命令
items.impact_scope: OA协同办公，内网常见
items.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and ABAP Platform does not perform necessary authorization checks for certain internal functionality. An attacker with low privileges could invoke affected functionality to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the underlying host. Successful exploitation could impact resources beyond the vulnerable component, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system.

items.title: 资源管理组件 路径遍历文件读取
items.title_zh: 资源管理组件 路径遍历文件读取
items.summary_zh: 攻击者经resourceId参数路径穿越，读取服务器可读的任意JSON文件
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息，校验resourceId路径
items.repro_note: 入口资源API，构造resourceId路径穿越读取JSON
items.impact_scope: 内部资源服务，可能泄露配置
items.description: The route passes the attacker-controlled resourceId through src/api/resources/index.ts to FileStore.getResource() in packages/resources-provider-plugin/src/filestorage.ts without adequate path containment, allowing arbitrary JSON files reachable by the server to be read. Reading security.json exposes the HS256 JWT signing secret and password hashes, allowing an attacker to forge an administrator token.

items.title: craft.search 未授权SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者经搜索attribute参数注入SQL，可堆叠查询并提权至管理员
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息，参数化查询并禁用堆叠
items.repro_note: 前端搜索接口，attribute 参数未过滤，可堆叠查询
items.impact_scope: 使用craft.search的站点
items.description: An unauthenticated SQL injection can occur on the front end of any site that uses craft.search to perform a search, allowing stacked query execution and enabling escalation to an administrator. Impact * SQL injection — The attribute parameter is concatenated into the query unsanitized, and because PDO runs with emulated prepares, stacked statements execute.

items.title: SAP WebDispatcher CSRF
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者诱导已登录管理员点击恶意链接，可完全控制底层系统
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 关注厂商补丁，管理员勿点未知链接
items.repro_note: 需管理员已登录并点击恶意链接，构造CSRF请求
items.impact_scope: SAP企业应用，内网核心
items.description: In the context of Application Server ABAP and SAP Web Dispatcher, an unauthenticated attacker could trick a logged-on administrator into visiting a malicious link. Successful exploitation could lead to a full compromise of the underlying operating system, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

items.title: Python tarfile 归档提取风险
items.title_zh: Python tarfile 归档提取风险
items.summary_zh: 具ADD/STATUS权限用户可提取含设备文件或FIFO的恶意tar包，造成高危影响
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 关注Python补丁，显式设置tarfile提取过滤器
items.repro_note: 需ADD/STATUS权限，构造含字符/块设备或FIFO的tar包
items.impact_scope: Python运行时，影响解包服务
items.description: On supported Python 3.9 through 3.13 runtimes, tarfile defaults to the fully_trusted extraction filter, so a user with ADD and STATUS permissions can cause extraction of a crafted archive containing character devices, block devices, or FIFOs. When pyLoad runs with operating-system privileges that permit device creation, including the official root-based Docker deployment, the archive can expose raw devices and compromise the host.

items.title: Plesk Site Import 路径遍历
items.title_zh: Plesk Site Import 路径遍历
items.summary_zh: 非所有者订阅用户经路径遍历劫持特权会话，以root执行任意代码
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级 Site Import 至 1.13.2
items.repro_note: 需订阅用户权限，操纵domain/session标识路径穿越
items.impact_scope: 主机管理面板，可提权至root
items.description: The Plesk extension "Site Import" before 1.13.2 does not properly validate domain and session identifiers, allowing path traversal. This lets a non-owner subscription user redirect a privileged backend session into a directory they control, resulting in arbitrary code execution as root.

items.title: AsyncSSH SFTP chroot绕过
items.summary_zh: SFTP用户可绕过chroot，以服务账号权限读写任意文件，或致代码执行
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 关注AsyncSSH修复，限制SFTP写入
items.repro_note: 需SFTP账号，构造路径绕过chroot读写文件
items.impact_scope: SSH/SFTP服务，可横向影响主机
items.description: AsyncSSH is a Python package which provides an asynchronous client and server implementation of the SSHv2 protocol on top of the Python asyncio framework. This bypasses the SFTP chroot and permits reads and writes with the operating-system permissions of the account running the server, which may enable code execution depending on writable targets.

items.title: DIAEnergie SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可经未净化参数注入SQL，读取或篡改数据库数据
items.repro_note: 定位输入参数，构造SQL注入语句
items.impact_scope: 工业能源管理系统，内网
items.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability in Deltaww DIAEnergie allows SQL Injection. This issue affects DIAEnergie: before 1.11.01.032.

items.title: CGM XDent 未授权 SQL注入
items.description: CGM XDent and XMedical expose PHP synchronization endpoints that allow unauthenticated attackers to manipulate session variables and execute arbitrary SQL queries against backend MySQL databases.

items.title: ION-DTN DGR整数溢出堆破坏
items.summary_zh: 攻击者向DGR汇聚层发特制64位svcDataLength报文触发整数回绕，破坏堆内存，可致崩溃或代码执行。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至4.2.0以上修复版本，限制DGR端口暴露
items.repro_note: 向DGR汇聚层发送超长svcDataLength报文触发整数回绕
items.impact_scope: DTN协议节点,航天专网环境
items.description: NASA JPL ION-DTN 2.2.1b through 4.2.0 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the Datagram Retransmission (DGR) convergence layer that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending a maliciously crafted 64-bit svcDataLength value that wraps a 32-bit allocation size calculation.

items.title: Improperly CWE-915
items.description: Improperly controlled modification of Dynamically-Determined object attributes vulnerability in C-Prot Inc. C-Prot AppDefense allows Privilege Escalation. This issue affects C-Prot AppDefense: before 1.0.2729.

items.title: Key 未授权 认证绕过
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Prior to 0.5.0b3.dev101, Api.check_apikey caches successful validation in self._apikey_cache using only the attacker-controlled key_id. Key identifiers are small sequential integers, so an unauthenticated remote attacker can enumerate an active identifier and inherit the cached key owner's permissions during the 300-second cache lifetime.

items.title: 权限提升
items.description: frab through 0.9.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows authenticated crew users to grant themselves orga roles by submitting unchecked nested conference_users_attributes. Attackers can abuse UsersController#update or #create, which skip filter_conference_users, to gain orga on any conference and fully manage its events, schedule, reviewers and crew.

items.title: 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: The shared client accepts caller-controlled doctor identifiers for read and write operations without requiring authentication or authorization credentials.

items.title: Wi-Fi 命令注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 中(需相邻网络·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: Fluxion before 6.39 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the fluxion.sh target scanner, which decodes access point ESSIDs with eval after escaping only single quotes. Attackers within Wi-Fi range can broadcast an access point with a crafted SSID to execute commands as root when the operator scans or selects it.

items.title: GV-Face 未授权 CWE-319
items.description: GV-Face transmits sensitive user credentials and related authentication data over unencrypted HTTP connections. The HTTP traffic is not encrypted, an attacker with the ability to intercept network traffic.

items.title: D-Link M60 未授权 CWE-259
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in D-Link M60 1.12.B01. Impacted is the function system of the file /etc/emDaemon/mosquitto.conf of the component emDaemon MQTT Broker. Such manipulation leads to hard-coded credentials. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: Successful 未授权 堆溢出
items.description: SAP Web Dispatcher does not sufficiently validate certain network input processed by an internal component. An unauthenticated attacker could send specially crafted network traffic to trigger a memory corruption condition in the affected functionality. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code and fully compromise the system, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system.

items.title: Tasmota 未授权 CWE-805
items.description: Tasmota through 16.0.0, fixed in commit e97e1e4, contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in SendReceiveDeviceGroupMessage() that allows unauthenticated attackers on the local network to corrupt heap memory by sending crafted Device Groups messages over UDP port 4447 that cause the log_remaining counter to go negative and writes to exceed the fixed 512-byte buffer.

items.title: Mongoose 未授权 CWE-943
items.description: Prior to 6.13.11, 7.8.12, 8.24.3, and 9.9.2, Mongoose countDocuments() does not apply the configured sanitizeFilter query selector injection defense. An application that enables sanitizeFilter and passes attacker-controlled filter values to countDocuments() can therefore process query operator objects as operators rather than literal values, causing the count to include documents that should not match and potentially undermining authorization or application logic based on that count.

items.title: NEC Corporation WebSAM WinShare 未授权 CWE-749
items.description: Improper Input Validation in the network communication processing in NEC Corporation WebSAM WinShare Ver 7.2.0 through 7.5.0, Ver 7.6.0 and Ver 7.7.0 through 7.7.2 on Windows allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands with SYSTEM privileges via a crafted network packet sent to the computer on which WinShare is running.

items.title: Buffer Overflow 未授权 堆溢出
items.description: Buffer Overflow in the data receiving process in NEC Corporation WebSAM WinShare Ver 7.5.0 and earlier, Ver 7.6.0 and Ver 7.7.0 through 7.7.2 on Windows allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges via a crafted packet with a malformed data size value in the protocol header.

items.title: Chaos Software V-Ray 未授权 CWE-427
items.description: Uncontrolled search path element in package upload feature in Chaos Software V-Ray versions through 2.0.19 allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via redirecting access to libraries

items.title: XXE
items.description: An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access restricted resources, enabling them to read sensitive files on the server and reach internal systems that are not otherwise exposed, impacting resources beyond the vulnerable component, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality and a low impact on both integrity and availability.

items.title: Zypp 路径遍历
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: A path traversal attack in simulation of actions in the Zypp backend of PackageKit before 1.4.1 could be used by local attackers to gain root privileges.

items.description: Improper access restrictions in the Thin Client Web Transfer component of Progress Software WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2025.0.5 on Windows could allow an authenticated FTP user to access files outside their intended scope.

items.title: BIRD 未授权 参数拼接注入
items.description: bird-lg-go is a BIRD looking glass in Go. Prior to version 1.4.7, unsanitized input path enables arbitrary local file read, allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to read sensitive files such as /etc/shadow and /root/.bash_history. This issue has been patched in version 1.4.7.

items.title: 命令注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: augment-vir is a collection of helper functions. Any downstream application that passes untrusted input to grep()'s pattern or patterns field is vulnerable to unauthenticated local (and potentially remote) code execution.

items.title: 命令注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 高(远程·利用条件苛刻·需高权限·需用户交互)
items.description: An unauthenticated attacker can inject a newline character into the username field to execute arbitrary shell commands as the versa OS service user. No credentials are required; the attacker needs only a CSRF token, which can be obtained from an unauthenticated page load.

items.title: Control Security Levels.This 未授权 缺失授权(越权)
items.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in weDevs weDocs wedocs allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects weDocs: from n/a through 2.6.1.

items.title: WP E-Signature Formidable Forms 未授权 缺失授权(越权)
items.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP E-Signature Formidable Forms Signature Online Contract Automation forms-signature-formidable-online-contract-automation allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Formidable Forms Signature Online Contract Automation: from n/a through 2.0.5.

items.title: PT Norther Lights Production 未授权 缺失授权(越权)
items.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in PT Norther Lights Production MapSVG mapsvg-lite-interactive-vector-maps allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects MapSVG: from n/a through 8.16.3.

items.title: API-key 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: Prior to 11.3.6, 11.4.6, and 12.0.8, app-specific management requests using an unknown tenant path and an older supported cdi-version can bypass API-key and public-tenant enforcement. An unauthenticated caller able to reach the Core endpoint can therefore use PUT /ghosttenant/recipe/role and GET /ghosttenant/recipe/roles to create and enumerate application roles without a valid API key.

items.title: Apple 未授权 授权错误
items.affected: Apple(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: An authorization issue was addressed with improved validation. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.3 and iPadOS 26.7.3, iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1, macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1, macOS Sequoia 15.8.3, macOS Tahoe 26.7.3, visionOS 27.2.1, watchOS 27.2.1. A remote attacker may be able to join an iMessage group chat and receive its messages.

items.title: SAP NetWeaver AS Java 未授权 缺失授权(越权)
items.description: SAP NetWeaver AS Java EDM Application does not perform an authentication check for certain web service requests. An unauthenticated attacker could send a specially crafted request to retrieve sensitive business information. This results in a high impact on confidentiality. There is no impact on integrity and availability.

items.title: SP-initiated 未授权 认证绕过(中间人)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: In the SP-initiated flow, an attacker who obtains a legitimately issued, still-valid SAML response and its matching RelayState can resubmit the pair to /recipe/saml/callback before the assertion's NotOnOrAfter time; in the IdP-initiated flow, the assertion can be replayed without RelayState. The missing Response.InResponseTo check also permits an in-progress login to be completed with an assertion for a different identity and fails to enforce allowIDPInitiatedLogin=false.

items.title: Tobias WP2LEADS 未授权 CWE-266
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Tobias WP2LEADS wp2leads allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects WP2LEADS: from n/a through 3.5.17.

items.title: SourceCodester Smart Attendance System 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in SourceCodester Smart Attendance System with QR Code Scanner 1.0. This impacts the function getMessage of the file create_admin.php of the component Admin Account Creation. Such manipulation of the argument e leads to missing authentication. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: SourceCodester Smart Attendance System 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Smart Attendance System with QR Code Scanner 1.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file api/attendance_handler.php of the component JSON Endpoint. Performing a manipulation of the argument student_code results in missing authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: Michael-A-Kuykendall Shimmy 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Michael-A-Kuykendall Shimmy up to 2.6.4. The affected element is an unknown function of the file src/server.rs of the component Inference API. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 2.6.5 is sufficient to fix this issue. The patch is named 3f2ee748c02eeb229987913fe289a2ed9a24595d. You should upgrade the affected component.

items.title: 未授权 硬编码凭据
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Multiple hardcoded credentials are embedded within product components and administrative functionalities. These credentials may enable unauthorized access to privileged accounts, services, or application features across affected deployments.

items.title: Webmin 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in samba/save_euser.cgi that allows authenticated Samba user maintainers to inject commands via unvalidated opts parameter. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters in account option flags passed by create_user and modify_user to backquote_logged, executing commands as root.

items.title: Successful 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: SAP ABAP Developer Tools (AMDP Data Preview) does not perform sufficient validation and authorization checks within certain affected functionality. An attacker with high privileges could submit specially crafted input to inject and execute arbitrary code on the system. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to fully compromise the system, resulting in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability.

items.title: Update 未授权 CWE-494
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Update components download and execute code without proper authenticity verification, relying on ignored hashes or forgeable checksums. Some update paths also permit archive traversal or script execution.

items.title: ASUS Router 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command in certain ASUS Router firmware allows an user with physical access to insert a USB device containing a specially crafted directory name, potentially executing arbitrary commands with root privileges. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: SQL注入
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.description: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in a database migration script in flowintel. An attacker who has previously written a malicious identifier value into the affected tables can cause arbitrary SQL execution when the migration is subsequently run during an application upgrade.

items.title: Incorrect Permission Assignment 权限错误
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource vulnerability in HAVELSAN Inc. Liman Render Engine allows Privilege Escalation. This issue affects Liman Render Engine: before 1.2-81.

items.title: Incorrect 权限错误
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.description: Incorrect permission assignment allows local privilege escalation to SYSTEM on affected releases of the Illumio VEN for Windows. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to modify the VEN configuration so that illumio-ven-ctl executes an injected command in the context of the SYSTEM account.

items.title: 权限提升
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.description: In apport before 2.37.0, an improper privilege management vulnerability allows an unprivileged local attacker to gain root privileges on systems where automatic crash reporting is enabled. This allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges and fully compromise the affected system.

items.title: Storyden 权限提升
items.description: Storyden through 1.26.16 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows users holding MANAGE_ROLES to grant the ADMINISTRATOR permission without being administrators. Attackers can call AccountAddRole on another controlled account or use RoleCreate and RoleUpdate to create administrator roles, taking full control of the instance.

items.title: Map-OS 权限提升
items.description: Map-OS 5.0.0 to before 5.2.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the REST users API that allows non-administrator operators holding the cUsuario permission to bypass permission-delegation and super-administrator protections. Attackers can send POST, PUT, or DELETE requests to /api/v1/usuarios to assign the Administrador group, reset the super administrator password, or delete higher-privileged users.
